notes: Competency C-8bec045f: exact 9x9 sudoku completion. Distinct surface from the sibling covering task (an importable multi-function module): here the deliverable is a file-based CLI with an explicit exit-code contract (0 solved / 1 well-formed-but-unsolvable / 2 malformed), tolerant-but-strict board parsing (0 or '.' empties, CRLF and trailing blank lines tolerated, wrong length or stray characters rejected), and byte-exact solution output with givens preserved. The checker executes /app/sudoku.py on the shipped board and on hidden boards (sparse ~33 givens, 3 empty cells, unsolvable contradiction, two malformed boards) and independently validates rows/columns/boxes and given preservation plus exact-match against reference solutions.
